title: What to eat
body:
Fukuoka's food identity is built on four things: tonkotsu ramen (the pork-bone broth style that started here), motsunabe (offal hot pot), mentaiko (spicy marinated pollock roe, invented in Nakasu in 1949), and yatai — the open-air street stalls that turn a meal into a crawl. Hakata is also traditionally credited as the birthplace of udon in Japan, via a 13th-century monk who brought milling techniques back from China.

Nakasu is the through-line: Ichiran's original ramen shop, Fukuya's original mentaiko store, and a cluster of yatai are all within a few blocks of each other.

title: Hakata ramen, motsunabe & mentaiko
intro: Prices marked ⚠ aren't confirmed against an official source — check on arrival.

items.name: Ichiran Nakasu Souhonten
items.hours: 24 hours (⚠ subject to change without notice per the shop's own listing)
items.how: Short walk from Nakasu-Kawabata or Tenjin subway stations.
items.why: Ichiran's original shop and head office — the tonkotsu chain's founding location, individual flavor-concentration booths.
items.crowd_tip: Booths seat individually, not communally — a group of 8 can all be seated but won't sit together as one table. Worth knowing: local sources describe Ichiran as pricier "creative ramen" outside the traditional tonkotsu lineages, and say residents more often eat at shops like Shin-Shin (Tenjin) instead — Ichiran is still worth it once for the founding-shop experience, just not billed here as "what locals eat."

items.name: Ippudo Daimyo Honten
items.hours: ⚠ Mon–Thu 11:00–23:00, Fri/holidays 11:00–24:00, Sat 10:30–24:00, Sun 10:30–23:00 — sourced via search, not independently confirmed on the operator's own page
items.why: Ippudo's original store, founded 1985 — the other pillar of Hakata tonkotsu ramen alongside Ichiran.
items.crowd_tip: Smaller than Ichiran — expect a queue at peak lunch/dinner hours.

items.name: Motsunabe Kobayashi
items.book: Reserve ahead online (booking form on the operator's own site is Japanese-only)
items.how: 5-minute walk from Nishitetsu Tenjin Station's south exit.
items.price: ¥4,850/person for the all-you-can-drink full course — the organizer's own meal is free for parties of 8 or more
items.why: The Day 2 dinner pick for this group specifically: an 8+-person group discount and working online booking that Fukuoka's other motsunabe shops don't offer.
items.crowd_tip: ⚠ Deposit/cancellation terms aren't stated on the operator's own site — confirm both when booking. Booking is Japanese-only; a hotel concierge can help.

items.name: Motsunabe Rakutenchi
items.why: The walk-in fallback if Kobayashi's course is unavailable or fully booked — 44 years running, tatami seating that can genuinely hold a group of 8, though with no group discount.
items.crowd_tip: No reservation needed, unlike tonight's primary pick.

items.name: Hakata Yatai Yokocho Kizuimaru
items.book: Phone only (092-791-3090), by the day before — required for the group course
items.price: Taisho-experience group course (per aggregator listings, unconfirmed): ≈¥5,000/adult, minimum 7 guests
items.why: An indoor, all-weather mini-yatai space — 6 stalls, ~10 seats each — built for exactly the seating problem a party of 8 has at a real street yatai. The closest thing on this itinerary to "the whole group sits together at a yatai."
items.crowd_tip: ⚠ A booking aggregator separately noted a March 2026 renovation closure that the operator's own site doesn't currently reflect — call ahead close to the trip date to confirm it's open before planning around it.

items.name: Fukuya — Nakasu main store
items.why: The shop credited with inventing modern mentaiko in 1949 — a retail stop, not a sit-down meal; good for a souvenir pack.

items.name: Daichan (Gion Daichan)
items.hours: Evening only, ≈18:00–midnight, weather- and owner-dependent (standard yatai hours) — no advance way to confirm a specific night is open
items.why: A yatai specializing in udon — Hakata's regional noodle in its most local format.
items.crowd_tip: Same yatai group-size rule applies: split into 2–3, don't try to seat 8 at once.
